title: Paper: ammonia application
text: article reproduces ammonia-oxidation application companion methodological paper (Ospina, Espinheira, Silva Barros, 2026), using ammonia dataset (Brownlee, 1965; n=21n = 21). model fitted paper logit(μt)=β1+β2xt2+β3xt3+β4xt2xt3 \mathrm{logit}(\mu_t) = \beta_1 + \beta_2 x_{t2} + \beta_3 x_{t3} +   \beta_4 x_{t2} x_{t3} mean, log⁡(σt2)=γ1+γ2xt3+γ3xt2xt3 \log(\sigma^2_t) = \gamma_1 + \gamma_2 x_{t3} + \gamma_3 x_{t2} x_{t3} dispersion, xt2x_{t2} = corr_ar (air flow) xt3x_{t3} = temp_agua (cooling water inlet temperature).

text: analysis can reproduced manually lower-level functions package:   reported paper, test reject H0H_0 conventional significance levels model, consistent adequate fit.
code: data(ammonia)  X <- cbind(1, ammonia$corr_ar, ammonia$temp_agua,            ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua) Z <- cbind(1, ammonia$temp_agua,            ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua)  fit <- simplex_fit(ammonia$perda, X, Z) fit #>  #> Simplex Regression  (n = 21 ; p = 4 ; q = 3 ) #>  #>        Estimate Std.Error z.value      Pr #> beta1  -12.9893    2.1038 -6.1742 < 0.001 #> beta2    0.1312    0.0363  3.6140 < 0.001 #> beta3    0.2705    0.1024  2.6408 0.00827 #> beta4   -0.0037    0.0017 -2.1473 0.03177 #> gamma1   3.8342    3.3908  1.1308 0.25815 #> gamma2  -0.4454    0.2882 -1.5456 0.12219 #> gamma3   0.0044    0.0024  1.8791 0.06024 #>  #> Log-likelihood: 100.4159  |  converged: TRUE  dg <- simplex_diag(fit) dg$Tn #> [1] 8.044735 dg$Un #> [1] 0.02977546 plot_influence(dg) set.seed(123) gof <- simplex_gof(ammonia$perda, X, Z, B = 50, verbose = FALSE) gof #> simplexgof: U_n = 0.0298  (Tn = 8.0447, B = 50) #>  #>  alpha boot_lo boot_hi decision_boot norm_lo norm_hi    decision_norm #>     1% -0.8371  0.0255     Reject H0 -2.5758  2.5758 Do not reject H0 #>     5% -0.7731  0.0120     Reject H0 -1.9600  1.9600 Do not reject H0 #>    10% -0.7330 -0.0010     Reject H0 -1.6449  1.6449 Do not reject H0 plot_gof_boot(gof)

title: Paper: PBSC application
text: article reproduces peripheral blood stem cell (PBSC) transplantation application companion methodological paper (Ospina, Espinheira, Silva Barros, 2026), using pbsc dataset (Edmonton Hematopoietic Institute - Alberta Health Services). response recovery CD34+ cell recovery rate, continuous proportion (0,1)(0, 1). constant-dispersion model used paper_pbsc() logit(μt)=β1+β2adj_aget+β3chemot \mathrm{logit}(\mu_t) = \beta_1 + \beta_2\,\mathrm{adj\_age}_t +   \beta_3\,\mathrm{chemo}_t log⁡(σt2)=γ1 \log(\sigma^2_t) = \gamma_1 adj_age adjusted patient-age variable chemo chemotherapy protocol indicator (0 = one-day, 1 = three-day protocol).

title: Introduction to simplexgof
text: simplexgof implements bootstrap-calibrated local-influence goodness--fit (GoF) test simplex regression models constant varying dispersion. package provides: simplex_fit(): fit simplex regression model via maximum likelihood, logit link mean log link dispersion. simplex_diag(): compute local-influence diagnostic quantities (TnT_n UnU_n statistics, individual influence measures CItC_{I_t}). simplex_gof(): run full parametric-bootstrap GoF test. Plotting functions visualise influence diagnostics, half-normal envelopes, bootstrap distribution UnU_n. vignette walks complete analysis using ammonia dataset bundled package.

title: Introduction to simplexgof
text: ammonia dataset (Brownlee, 1965) 21 observations proportion ammonia lost industrial oxidation process, together three covariates. response perda proportion (0,1)(0, 1), making natural candidate simplex regression.

title: Introduction to simplexgof
text: model mean μt\mu_t covariates corr_ar, temp_agua, interaction, allow dispersion σt2\sigma^2_t depend temp_agua interaction term. fitted object class "simplexfit", print, coef, fitted methods.
code: X <- cbind(1, ammonia$corr_ar, ammonia$temp_agua,            ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua) Z <- cbind(1, ammonia$temp_agua,            ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua)  fit <- simplex_fit(ammonia$perda, X, Z) fit #>  #> Simplex Regression  (n = 21 ; p = 4 ; q = 3 ) #>  #>        Estimate Std.Error z.value      Pr #> beta1  -12.9893    2.1038 -6.1742 < 0.001 #> beta2    0.1312    0.0363  3.6140 < 0.001 #> beta3    0.2705    0.1024  2.6408 0.00827 #> beta4   -0.0037    0.0017 -2.1473 0.03177 #> gamma1   3.8342    3.3908  1.1308 0.25815 #> gamma2  -0.4454    0.2882 -1.5456 0.12219 #> gamma3   0.0044    0.0024  1.8791 0.06024 #>  #> Log-likelihood: 100.4159  |  converged: TRUE coef(fit) #>         beta1         beta2         beta3         beta4        gamma1  #> -12.989277095   0.131221084   0.270456444  -0.003688490   3.834204684  #>        gamma2        gamma3  #>  -0.445382852   0.004442287

title: Introduction to simplexgof
text: simplex_diag() computes case-weight local-influence measures CItC_{I_t} test statistics TnT_n UnU_n aggregate . quantities can visualised plot_influence(), produces index plot individual influence values CItC_{I_t}:
code: dg <- simplex_diag(fit) dg$Tn #> [1] 8.044735 dg$Un #> [1] 0.02977546 plot_influence(dg)

title: Introduction to simplexgof
text: first-order asymptotic normal calibration UnU_n known liberal small samples, simplex_gof() provides parametric bootstrap calibration. B = 50 replicates (speed vignette; use larger B, e.g. 1000, practice): bootstrap distribution UnU_n H0H_0 can visualised plot_gof_boot():
code: set.seed(42) gof <- simplex_gof(ammonia$perda, X, Z, B = 50, alpha = 0.01,                     verbose = FALSE) gof #> simplexgof: U_n = 0.0298  (Tn = 8.0447, B = 50) #>  #>  alpha boot_lo boot_hi    decision_boot norm_lo norm_hi    decision_norm #>     1% -0.8248  0.0424 Do not reject H0 -2.5758  2.5758 Do not reject H0 plot_gof_boot(gof)

title: simplexgof — Bootstrap GoF Test for Simplex Regression
text: simplexgof implements bootstrap-calibrated local-influence goodness--fit (GoF) test simplex regression models constant varying dispersion (Ospina, Espinheira, Silva Barros, 2026). key finding companion paper standard normal approximation null distribution test statistic UnU_n severely liberal finite samples — empirical rejection rates correctly specified model range 3 7 times nominal level. parametric bootstrap fully corrects , preserving high power. package also provides one-call functions reproduce every table figure paper.

(2026) set.seed(123) res <- paper_ammonia(B = 1000)   # set B = 200 for a quick run  # Access individual components print(res$table_params)          # Table 5: parameter estimates print(res$table_gof)             # Table 6: GoF test results plot_influence(res$diag)         # Figure 2: influence index plot plot_gof_boot(res$gof)           # Figure 3: bootstrap distribution  # ── 2. Manual workflow ───────────────────────────────────────────── data(ammonia) X   <- cbind(1, ammonia$corr_ar, ammonia$temp_agua,              ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua) Z   <- cbind(1, ammonia$temp_agua,              ammonia$corr_ar * ammonia$temp_agua) fit <- simplex_fit(ammonia$perda, X, Z)   # fit model dg  <- simplex_diag(fit)                  # compute U_n = 0.0298 gof <- simplex_gof(ammonia$perda, X, Z, B = 1000, seed = 123) print(gof) simplexgof: U_n = 0.0298  (Tn = 8.0447, B = 1000)   alpha boot_lo boot_hi    decision_boot    1%  -1.0028  0.0611 Do not reject H0    5%  -0.7312  0.0405 Do not reject H0   10%  -0.6320  0.0283        Reject H0

title: simplexgof — Bootstrap GoF Test for Simplex Regression
text: Un=n[∑t=1nCIt(θ̂)−2k]sk,cU_n = \frac{\sqrt{n}\bigl[\sum_{t=1}^n C_{I_t}(\hat\theta) - 2k\bigr]}{s_{k,c}} CIt=2Δt⊤(−ℓ̈)−1ΔtC_{I_t} = 2\Delta_t^\top(-\ddot\ell)^{-1}\Delta_t total local influence observation tt case-weight perturbation. H0H_0 (correct specification), Un→N(0,1)U_n \N(0,1), bootstrap calibration strongly preferred.

text: Provides bootstrap-calibrated local-influence goodness--fit test simplex regression models constant varying dispersion. methodology described Ospina, Espinheira, Silva Barros (2026). package authored maintained Raydonal Ospina. Main functions: Datasets: ammonia (n = 21) pbsc (n = 239).

text: Author Maintainer: Raydonal Ospina raydonal@de.ufpe.br (ORCID)

title: simplexgof 0.1.0
text: First release. simplex_fit(): maximum-likelihood fit simplex regression model constant varying dispersion (logit/log links), C++ kernels via Rcpp. simplex_gof(): parametric bootstrap-calibrated goodness--fit test based aggregated local-influence statistic U_n. simplex_diag(): local-influence diagnostics, choice analytic (bootstrap-invariant) finite-difference gradient. simplex_Un_asymptotic(): asymptotic version statistic null-distribution study. Plotting: plot_influence(), plot_envelope() (bootstrap envelope), plot_gof_boot(), plus plot() methods fitted test objects. Reproduction helpers: paper_ammonia(), paper_pbsc(), paper_fig1(), standalone scripts inst/scripts/. Two bundled datasets: ammonia (n = 21) pbsc (n = 239).
